lose.body_one: Losing {{kg}} kg takes about {{count}} day at a safe deficit of at most 1,000 kcal a day. At that pace you get there around {{date}}.
lose.body_other: Losing {{kg}} kg takes about {{count}} days at a safe deficit of at most 1,000 kcal a day. At that pace you get there around {{date}}.

gain.body_other: Gaining {{kg}} kg at a safe pace takes about {{count}} days. At that pace you get there around {{date}}.

lose.body_other: {{kg}} kg still to lose. At a safe deficit of at most 1,000 kcal a day that takes about {{count}} days, so you get there around {{date}}.

targetDate.title: Target date
targetDate.subtitle: When you want to get there
targetDate.hint: Pick a date and your daily eating target adjusts with it.
targetDate.error: Pick tomorrow or a later date.

tooFast.title: This date needs a deficit of ~{{deficit}} kcal a day, above the safe limit.
tooFast.body_one: JoyoRogo caps the deficit at about 1,000 kcal a day. Losing {{kg}} kg at that pace takes about {{count}} day.
tooFast.body_other: JoyoRogo caps the deficit at about 1,000 kcal a day. Losing {{kg}} kg at that pace takes about {{count}} days.

preview.changed: Eating target becomes {{next}} kcal a day (now {{current}}).
preview.same: Eating target stays {{kcal}} kcal a day.

targetDate.ok_one: Good. Losing {{kg}} kg in {{count}} day, {{perWeek}} kg a week, is a safe pace.
targetDate.ok_other: Good. Losing {{kg}} kg in {{count}} days, {{perWeek}} kg a week, is a safe pace.

slow.title: That date is quite far out.
slow.body: That pace is relaxed, so JoyoRogo still uses a minimum deficit of {{deficit}} kcal a day. At that rate you reach your target around {{date}}.

targetDate.maintenance: You're already at your target weight, so this date doesn't change your daily numbers yet. A new date matters once your target weight is below your current weight.
targetDate.previewFailed: Couldn't work out the daily numbers. You can still save the date.

activity.title: Activity level
activity.subtitle: How active your everyday days are

sleepTarget.title: Sleep goal
sleepTarget.subtitle: Recommended for adults: 7–9 hours a night.
sleepTarget.lowNote: Still within NSF's acceptable range (6–10 hours), but below the recommended minimum of 7 hours.

note.MAINTENANCE: Your weight is already in the healthy range, so your plan maintains it instead of losing.
note.BELOW_HEALTHY_RANGE: Your target weight is below the healthy range for your height. Consider raising it.
note.PLAN_CLAMPED: Your plan was adjusted to stay safe: the daily deficit is capped.
note.GAIN: Your plan is to gain weight: you eat a little above your daily needs (TDEE plus a surplus).

noteShort.MAINTENANCE: You've reached your target weight. Your plan now maintains your weight.
noteShort.BELOW_HEALTHY_RANGE: Your target weight is below the healthy range. Raise it a little to stay safe.
noteShort.PLAN_CLAMPED: Your plan was adjusted to stay safe. The calorie deficit is capped.
noteShort.GAIN: Gain weight plan: eating target = TDEE plus a surplus.

summary.withRange: Target: {{kg}} kg by {{date}}. Healthy range for your height: {{min}}–{{max}} kg.

empty.title: No plan yet
empty.body: You haven't completed your personal info. Finish onboarding to get a daily plan.

needs.title: Your daily needs
needs.intro: Step by step, from your body to today's eating target.

bmr.label: BMR
bmr.name: Body at rest
bmr.body: The energy your body uses at complete rest: breathing, heartbeat, staying warm. Worked out from your weight, height, age and sex.

activity.label: Activity factor
activity.name: Everyday movement
activity.body: Your BMR times the factor of the level you chose ({{level}}). It covers walking, work, chores and the effect of eating, outside of the workouts you log.

tdee.label: TDEE
tdee.name: Total needs
tdee.body: The total energy your body burns in a day. Eat this much and your weight stays the same.

cut.label: Minus for weight loss
cut.name: Food cut
cut.body: A cut from your TDEE so your body draws on fat stores. Its size comes from the gap between your weight and your target, and your target date. The whole cut comes out of food.

cutNone.label: No cut
cutNone.name: Holding weight
cutNone.body: You're already at your target weight, so you eat as much as your TDEE to hold it. Movement beyond your factor is added on top.

target.label: Eating target
target.name: Your allowance
target.body: The number you see on Beranda.

needs.burnNote: Your whole planned deficit, about {{deficit}} kcal a day, comes out of food. The exercise you log is added to what is left that day.

enabled.title: Add extra movement
enabled.hint: Movement your watch or Health measures beyond what your activity level already contains, and the workouts you log outside the watch's total, add to what you can eat that day. Low movement never lowers your target.

pct.title: How much is counted
pct.hint: Watches and apps often overestimate calories. 75% is a safe middle.
pct.aria: Share of activity that is counted

cap.title: Daily cap
cap.hint: Activity never adds more than this.
cap.aria: Daily cap on added activity calories

theme.label: Display theme
theme.hint: Dark mode follows your system setting when you pick System.

hint.auto: Meal slots follow the Hijri calendar.

ramadan.hintNative: Meal slots switch to suhoor & iftar; your daily numbers are split across the eating window.

notify.title: Reminder notifications
notify.hint: Web Push when the window opens, at mealtimes, and 30 minutes before it closes.

hint.off: Pick 16:8, 18:6, 20:4, or OMAD to start. Ramadan mode still takes priority.
hint.window: Fast for {{fast}} hours, eat within a {{eat}}-hour window.
hint.omad: One meal a day, within a window of about 1 hour.
hint.nativeOn: {{label}}: notifications appear when the window opens, at mealtimes, and 30 minutes before it closes.

error.unsupported: This browser doesn't support push notifications yet.
error.serverNotReady: The server isn't ready to send notifications. Try again later.
error.noKeys: The browser didn't send subscription keys.

status.notConfiguredServer: Connecting will work once Strava credentials are set on the server.
status.comingSoon: Coming soon: Strava activities will go into your burn numbers automatically.
status.idle: Strava activities are added to Burn automatically.
status.connectHintNative: Connect your Strava account to import your workouts automatically.

callback.title: Strava isn't connected
callback.noCode: Strava didn't send an authorization code. Try connecting again from the Profile page.

error.noCode: Strava didn't return an authorization code.

slots.full: Every Strava slot is taken. Try again later. Meanwhile burned calories still come in through Health Connect (Android) or Apple Health (iPhone), or add workouts by hand in Exercise.
slots.released: Your Strava connection was released because it had not been used for a long time. If a slot is open, you can connect it again. Burned calories can also come in through Health Connect (Android) or Apple Health (iPhone), or add workouts by hand in Exercise.

retention.text: Under Strava's rules, activities imported from Strava are kept for only 7 days, then deleted automatically. Burned calories for older days no longer include them.
retention.healthAlternative: To keep your burned calories saved, use Health Connect on Android or Apple Health on iPhone through the JoyoRogo app. Many workout apps and watches can write workouts there, for example Strava, Garmin, Samsung Health, and JoyoFit for Huawei watches. Check each app's settings.
retention.healthAlternativeNative: To keep your burned calories saved, connect {{health}} in Profile. Many workout apps and watches can write workouts there, for example Strava, Garmin, Samsung Health, and JoyoFit for Huawei watches. Check each app's settings.
retention.noticeTitle: Strava imports are kept for 7 days

permissionOff.message: JoyoRogo notifications are turned off in your system settings, so the reminders below won't show up.

meal.fastingNote: Intermittent fasting notifications are on, so meal reminders follow your fasting schedule and the times above aren't used.

window.needPattern: Pick a fasting pattern first under Intermittent fasting
window.openDuplicateNote: Intermittent fasting notifications already remind you when the window opens, so the opening reminder here isn't sent twice.

reminders.footnote: Reminders are notifications on this device, so they don't move to another phone or the web. Meal and weigh-in reminders are skipped if today is already logged when JoyoRogo was last opened or you log in the app. Entries from other devices are only picked up after the app is opened again. Water reminders always show on schedule.
reminders.webNote: Reminders for logging meals, drinking water, and weighing in live in the Android and iOS apps: open Profile in the app, then set a time for each reminder under Reminders. They're stored on your phone, not your account, so they don't show up on the web. Intermittent fasting notifications above can still be turned on in your browser.

error.startBeforeEnd: The start time must be before the end time.
error.endAfterStart: The end time must be after the start time.

permission.askMessage: JoyoRogo sends reminders to log meals, drink water, weigh in, and for your fasting window, at the times you choose. Notifications are only for that, no ads. After this, your system will ask for permission once.
permission.blockedMessage: Android or iOS no longer shows the permission prompt for JoyoRogo. Turn on JoyoRogo notifications in Settings, then come back here and turn the reminders on again.

windowOpen.title: Eating window opens

scanSimple.title: Simple mode after a scan
scanSimple.label: Simple mode
scanSimple.on: After a scan you only see the food list, one mic button to fix it, and Save. Everything else is under Details.
scanSimple.off: The full scan result screen with every option.

share.hintWeb: Only your starting weight to your current weight. No email, no food data.
share.hintNative: A light public page with your weight trend; no name or email.
share.copied: Link copied, just paste it into Threads.

keepPhotos.title: Keep original photos
keepPhotos.label: Original photos
keepPhotos.onWeb: You can view them again in your diary, only you.
keepPhotos.offWeb: Off: only the cut-out of each food is kept.
keepPhotos.onNative: The original photo of each scan you save can be viewed again in your diary. Only you can open it. Turning this off deletes all stored original photos.
keepPhotos.offNative: Only the cut-out of each food is kept as a sticker. The original photo is discarded after analysis.
keepPhotos.toast: Original photos will be kept from your next scan.

confirm.title: Turn off keeping original photos?
confirm.descriptionWeb: Original photos already stored are permanently deleted too.
confirm.bodyWeb: Your food logs and each food's sticker stay. Only the original photos are deleted.
confirm.actionWeb: Yes, turn off and delete original photos
confirm.messageNative: Original photos already stored are permanently deleted too. Your food logs and each food's sticker stay.

wipe.title: Delete all my data
wipe.subtitleWeb: Profile, weight, food, exercise, sleep. Permanent.
wipe.subtitleNative: Permanent: profile, weight, food, exercise, sleep
wipe.confirmDescription: This is permanent and can't be undone.
wipe.confirmBodyWeb: All your records are deleted: profile, weight, food, exercise, sleep. Your account stays usable, but you start again from zero.
wipe.confirmMessageNative: Your profile, weight, food, exercise, and sleep are permanently deleted. Your account stays usable.
wipe.done: All your data has been deleted.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.subtitle: Permanent: your account and all your data are gone
delete.confirmMessage: Your account and all your data (profile, logs, photos, posts, groups) are permanently deleted and can't be restored. You'll need to sign up again to use JoyoRogo.
delete.noAppleCode: Apple didn't send an authorization code. Try again.

health.noteIos: The main source of your activity: workouts, steps, distance, active calories, and the last 7 days of sleep from the Health app. Once you grant permission with the button below, syncing runs automatically each time you open the app.
health.noteAndroid: The main source of your activity: workouts, steps, distance, active calories, and the last 7 days of sleep. Once permission is granted, syncing runs automatically each time you open the app.
health.nutritionNote: Write your food (calories, protein, carbs, fat, fiber) to Health Connect so other apps can read it. New foods, edits, and deletes sync automatically once permission is granted.

summary.iosEmpty: No data could be read. Check permissions in Settings > Health > Data Access & Devices, then try again.

health.nutritionWritten_one: {{count}} meal from the last 30 days was written to Health Connect.

dishware.title: My plates
dishware.intro: Register the plates and bowls you usually eat from, once. Their size becomes the reference when the AI estimates portions from a photo, so grams land closer to reality. Eating somewhere else? No problem, the scan works as usual.
dishware.empty: No plates yet. Add one, just once.
dishware.full: You have {{max}} plates. Remove one to add another.

form.title: New plate or bowl
form.photoHint: An empty plate or bowl, photographed straight from above. The AI writes down what it looks like once, so it can recognise your plate in food photos later.
form.name: Name
form.diameterHelp: Measure with a ruler, or lay a bank card next to it.

measure.result: Estimate from the card: {{cm}} cm. Check with a ruler if you can, and change the number if it differs.
measure.noCard: The card is not clearly visible in the photo. Lay it flat next to the plate and take the photo again, or just type the diameter.
measure.failed: The photo could not be read. Try again from straight above with enough light.

dishware.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? Its photo and size are removed too.

dataSources.title: Food data sources
dataSources.intro: Numbers from the AI are always estimates. When your dish is in one of the tables below, the estimate is adjusted to the table.
dataSources.tkpi: Indonesian dishes: Indonesian Food Composition Table (TKPI) 2019, Ministry of Health of Indonesia.
dataSources.sgfoodid: Malaysian dishes: Singapore Food Insights Database (SG FoodID), Health Promotion Board. The source notice, as required:
dataSources.notice: Contains information from Singapore Food Insights Database (SG FoodID) accessed on 2026-10-21 from Health Promotion Board which is made available under the terms found at https://pphtpc.hpb.gov.sg/web/sgfoodid. The information contained within this dataset is provided on an "as-is" basis. The data, including but not limited to nutritional information, is subject to inherent limitations. No warranty or representation is made as to the accuracy or completeness of the data contained herein.
